_comment: Pins Jellyfin's log levels. Copy to ${CONFIG_DIRECTORY}/jellyfin/config/logging.json
with `make jellyfin-logging` and restart Jellyfin once.
This is NOT here to raise verbosity. On 10.11.11 the line that makes stage 4
-- is already Information level and already logged. docs/music-pipeline-integration.md
sec 8.3 claimed it was a Debug line and that verification was impossible; that was
wrong, and acting on it would have meant a pointless restart plus global debug noise.
What this file buys is that a future Jellyfin upgrade cannot silently move that
category to Debug and take the pipeline's only observability with it. The override
below pins it at Information explicitly rather than inheriting Default.
Everything else is upstream's logging.default.json verbatim (10.11.11). Keep it that
way: the WriteTo block controls log rotation and a mistake here loses logs.
Jellyfin hot-reloads this file ONLY if it existed at the last server start. Creating
it fresh needs exactly one restart -- once, ever. `make check` asserts the repo copy
exists so a fresh deploy cannot rediscover that.
